solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Relative of Nahum oddly left out by bible books

indicators.note: by means beside, so the second piece sits next to the first
the odd-placed letters of Nahum are dropped, keeping only the even ones

parts.note: NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A reader notes that the prophet Nahum is partly missing from some books of scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing the odd letters (N, H, M) of Nahum leaves its 2nd and 4th letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's sister is a family relation, one kind of relative.

clue.text: About to get found out, broke up

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
rumbled is British slang for discovered or seen through

explanation.surface: Someone on the verge of being exposed falls apart under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rumbled' is British informal for having one's secret discovered.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that broke up into fragments has crumbled; a direct synonym.

clue.text: Large number of people entering new complaint of aches and pains in backside?

indicators.note: in places the new complaint within the other piece

parts.note: read as back side: a side is a team of eleven, XI, turned back to give IX
flu is an illness bringing aches and pains

explanation.surface: A patient reports a fresh ailment, aches and pains in the rear end.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the trick: 'backside' is split as back + side, with side = XI (a team of eleven) reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: An influx is a mass arrival, a large flow of people coming in.

clue.text: Detective takes cab, going out with hot bird

indicators.note: takes means the detective's word holds the other letters within it

parts.note: dick is slang for a private detective

indicators.note: going out suggests the word cab is thrown out of order and rearranged

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: A private eye hails a cab and goes out on a date with an attractive woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Going out' rearranges the letters of cab before they and H go inside. 'Bird' looks like British slang for a girlfriend, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The dabchick is the little grebe, a small diving water bird.

clue.text: Only son, legless, trips over end of garden hose

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of garden
trips over suggests letters stumbling and falling into a new order
in cricket the leg side is also called the on side, so legless means losing the letters ON

explanation.surface: An only child, drunk, stumbles over the garden hosepipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Legless' is British slang for very drunk; here it removes ON (cricket's leg side is the on side) from SON, leaving S.
explanation.definitionFit: Hose means stockings, and nylons are stockings made of that synthetic fibre.

clue.text: Arsenal content, after repelling most Spurs' headers

indicators.note: headers here are the heading letters of the four words that follow, a football term doubling for initials

explanation.surface: A football report: Arsenal are pleased after fending off most of Tottenham Hotspur's headed attempts.
explanation.walkthrough: Arsenal and Spurs (Tottenham Hotspur) are rival London football clubs; 'content' looks like 'happy' but means contents.
explanation.definitionFit: An arsenal is a store of weapons, so what it contains is weaponry.

clue.text: Dog gets musical present

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
Rent is a Broadway rock musical by Jonathan Larson

explanation.surface: A dog receives a gift that plays music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present' looks like a gift, but it is the adjective meaning now.
explanation.definitionFit: Present as an adjective means of the moment, existing now: a synonym.

clue.text: Alloy regularly found in tough rope

indicators.note: found in places the picked letters inside the word for tough

parts.note: hard means tough or firm

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of alloy, starting with the first

explanation.surface: Metal strands are discovered woven into a strong rope.
explanation.definitionFit: A halyard is a line used on a ship for hoisting sails or flags.

clue.text: Couple having sex repulsed this writer

parts.note: it is old slang for sex appeal or sex itself

indicators.note: repulsed means pushed back, so the word for the writer is turned around

parts.note: the writer of the clue refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A writer is put off by a pair who are making love.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantically linked couple is called an item in informal speech.

clue.text: It's laughable how iCloud's URL almost got hacked

indicators.note: something hacked is cut up and broken into, so the letters are jumbled
almost means the last letter of the web address word is not used

explanation.surface: A mocking remark on how easily an Apple cloud account's web address was breached.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe something so absurd that it invites laughter: a synonym.

clue.text: Reserved other papers for emergency room

indicators.note: papers for emergency room means one replaces the other in the word

parts.note: other means different
ID, identity documents, are one's papers

explanation.surface: Another set of documents was kept back for use in the hospital's emergency department.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reserved' looks like 'set aside' but is the adjective meaning shy.
explanation.definitionFit: A reserved person is shy and lacking in confidence: a synonym.

clue.text: What reverses 59 and, in turn, is double this

definitions.text: and, in turn, is double this

indicators.note: reverses means the word for what is read backwards

parts.note: eh? is an exclamation meaning what?
LIX is 59 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A riddling question about what turns a number around.
explanation.walkthrough: In the definition, 'and, in turn' is AND turned around: DNA, whose structure is a double one of these.
explanation.definitionFit: DNA's molecular structure is famously a twin spiral, described by Crick and Watson.

clue.text: Dye used in kitchen, naturally

indicators.note: used in signals letters lying within the next two words

explanation.surface: A colouring agent is used in cooking, as you would expect.
explanation.definitionFit: Henna is a reddish-brown plant dye used on hair and skin.

clue.text: Fellow Scotswoman has iron that's unlikely to go wrong

parts.note: Ailsa is a Scottish woman's name
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A man's Scottish companion owns an iron that won't break down.
explanation.definitionFit: A design that is built to stay safe even when something breaks is hard to make go wrong.

clue.text: Bent piece of cutlery shortly before time to eat starter

indicators.note: before puts the shortened cutlery ahead of the rest
shortly means the cutlery word is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a fork is a piece of cutlery

indicators.note: starter takes the opening letter of eat

explanation.surface: A twisted fork appears just before it is time to eat the first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bent' looks like 'twisted', but it is the noun meaning a natural talent.
explanation.definitionFit: A bent is a natural aptitude, and a forte is a person's strong point.

clue.text: Aim to include one film about children's writer

indicators.note: to include means the word for aim holds the next piece inside it

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A plan to put one movie about an author of children's books into production.
explanation.walkthrough: The 2009 BBC film Enid was about Enid Blyton, the children's author.
explanation.definitionFit: A biopic of Enid Blyton bore just her first name as its title.

clue.text: Use of mouse with wrong hand causes muscle spasm

indicators.note: the wrong hand swaps left for right, so L becomes R

parts.note: a click is the action of using a computer mouse

explanation.surface: Operating a computer mouse with the wrong hand brings on a muscle twinge.
explanation.definitionFit: A crick is a painful stiffness or spasm, usually in the neck or back.

clue.text: A guitar in care of male singer

indicators.note: in means the guitar piece sits within the care-of letters

parts.note: c/o is the postal abbreviation for care of
a Strat is a Fender Stratocaster guitar

explanation.surface: A guitar is left in the keeping of a male vocalist.
explanation.definitionFit: A castrato was a male singer castrated before puberty to keep a high voice.

clue.text: British painter hasn't married Hungarian inventor

indicators.note: hasn't means the painter's name goes without the married letter

parts.note: Joan Miro was a Spanish painter

explanation.surface: A British artist is still single.
explanation.walkthrough: 'British painter' reads as one person, but B and the Spanish painter Miro are separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Laszlo Biro, a Hungarian, invented the ballpoint pen that bears his name.

clue.text: Film producer, a member of the Greens

definitions.meaning: Albert 'Cubby' ... produced the James Bond films
greens are green vegetables, and this is one of them

explanation.surface: A movie producer who belongs to the Green Party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greens' looks like the political party, but means green vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: Cubby Broccoli produced the Bond films, and broccoli is a green vegetable.

clue.text: Destroy note, always rewritten beforehand

indicators.note: beforehand puts the rearranged word ahead of the note
rewritten means the letters of always are set down again in another order

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: An instruction to tear up a memo, which always gets redrafted first.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay waste is an idiom for ravaging or devastating completely.

clue.text: Doctor present upset nurses when taking temperature

indicators.note: nurses means holds, as one nurses a drink, so one piece goes inside the other
upset in a down clue turns the word upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: now means the present time

indicators.note: taking means the when-word takes the next letter inside it

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: A doctor is upset that nurses are taking patients' temperatures right now.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' turns the present word to WON, and 'taking' puts T inside the word for when, giving ATS for the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Dr Watson is Sherlock Holmes's companion in the Conan Doyle stories.

clue.text: Too respectable to hum during prayer

indicators.note: during means the smell piece falls within the prayer

parts.note: an Ave is the Ave Maria prayer
hum is British slang for a bad smell, and BO is body odour

explanation.surface: Someone too proper to hum along while prayers are said.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hum' looks like singing but is British slang for a stink, BO.
explanation.definitionFit: To be above doing something is to consider oneself too good or principled for it.

clue.text: Take in type of blood brothers set-up

parts.note: AB is one of the blood groups

indicators.note: set-up in a down clue sends the word upwards, reading it backwards

explanation.surface: A system set up by a group of blood brothers.
explanation.definitionFit: To absorb is to soak up or assimilate, the same as take in.

clue.text: Record the other island's disease

parts.note: to enter is to record, as in a ledger
the other is British slang for sex, which is also it
IS is the abbreviation for island, with 's meaning is

explanation.surface: Logging the illness found on a second island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The other' is British euphemism for sex, as is 'it'.
explanation.definitionFit: Enteritis is inflammation of the intestine, an illness.

clue.text: An elder twin brother of one's 1

indicators.note: of signals letters taken from within the phrase that follows

parts.note: 1 refers to the answer at 1 down, so the phrase reads one's plus that relative

explanation.surface: A cryptic family puzzle: the senior twin is brother to your relative.
explanation.walkthrough: Put the answer to 1 down after 'one's' and the name lies across the join.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis this son of Isaac was born just before his twin, Jacob.

clue.text: Essential point of a tenth vineyard?

parts.note: a cru is a French vineyard or its wine
X is the Roman numeral ten, so a tenth one is number X

explanation.surface: Asking what the key feature of a vineyard's tithe might be.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the whimsy: vineyard number ten would be cru X.
explanation.definitionFit: The crux of a matter is its central or decisive point.

clue.text: Trick cycling drug addict

indicators.note: cycling means letters go round from one end of the word to the other

parts.note: a ruse is a trick

explanation.surface: A con involving bicycles carried out by someone on drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cycling' moves the R of RUSE from the front to the back.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who uses drugs habitually is called a user.

clue.text: Actor taking 5 off before start of sex romps

indicators.note: before puts the rearranged letters ahead of the final letter
off means gone wrong, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: V is 5 in Roman numerals

indicators.note: start of takes the first letter of sex

explanation.surface: A performer taking five minutes off before the love scene.
explanation.walkthrough: '5' looks like a reference to 5 down, but it is simply the Roman V.
explanation.definitionFit: To cavort is to leap or frolic about, which is what romping means.

clue.text: Travelling food supplier returned, still going round pitch

indicators.note: going round means the reversed word surrounds the other piece
returned means the word for still is read backwards

parts.note: yet means still, as in 'not yet'
to pitch and roll is how a ship moves, so pitch here means roll

explanation.surface: A mobile food seller comes back, still circling the sports pitch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pitch' looks like the playing field, but means a ship's motion, ROLL.
explanation.definitionFit: A refreshment cart is wheeled along trains and aircraft aisles serving food.
